lines.en: Stone claws scrape the cliff
I shift slowly through the night wind
Stone wings glide along the rock
Each step grinds gravel to dust
I walk between the stony peaks
My heavy steps raise dust
My stone legs creak forward
I patrol beneath the moonlight
Gravel slides off my shoulders
I round the broken cliff edge
My shadow stretches on the shore
I head for a darker crevice
I stand still as a statue
Night dew gathers in my cracks
I hold perfectly still
Only my eye sockets hold light
I count the waves below
The wind wears at my horns
Fine cracks crawl across my hide
I hold my stone breath
The dark hardens on my back
I listen to the stones speak
My grey eyes turn to you
You stepped into my shadow
My stone face swings toward you

lines.zh: 石鼻也能记住活人的气
lines.en: Even a stone nose remembers the living.
You look up at me from below
My gaze falls heavy on you
You should not wake the watchman
Cold seeps out of my cracks
I see the torch in your hand
I tilt my head and study you
A chip breaks off my hide
I give up half a step
My cracks run deeper
That barely counted
I shake off the debris
Even stone can ache
I am still standing
Do not think I am breaking
I steady my shaking shoulder
The night is long, I will last
Stone does not eat your bread
No food will move me an inch
You set meat on the rock
I sniff it and care nothing
I feed on moonlight and rock salt
Put it away, I am not hungry
Your bait means nothing to stone
Only tremors interest me
I have no need to eat at all
Food buys no loyalty from stone
You hit a wall of stone
My shoulder is harder than rock
You rebound half a step
My stone arm stops your charge
Do not shove, I will not budge
You daze yourself on me
Grit falls between us
My weight pins you back
You hear something like joints creak
Hitting me is hitting a mountain
My mate waits on a far peak
We call each other in stone song
Even a thousand-year body misses
I wait on the ridge for an answer
Another stone shape lands opposite
We stand shoulder to shoulder
Our stone wings touch once
I offer her a patch of moss
The night wind carries our words
Even a stone heart softens
I gather up my own shards
This fragment belongs to me
I pinch up a loose stone
The shard grows warm in my palm
I press it back into my crack
I pick up a worn stone fang
This one I will keep
I stack the rubble in a ring
I pocket the fallen core
My collection grows again
Something living moves below
I hear a stone being stepped on
That shadow moves too fast
My eyes have locked on you
Someone entered the peaks
The target is past that crevice
I smell warm blood
You woke the whole cliff
Wings spread, I mark you
The prey stands in moonlight
I hear your heartbeat
You cannot leave this shore
I have chosen you
My stone claws tighten
The hunt begins now
Run, and I will follow
My steps will not stop
My stone eyes stay on you
You cannot hide your breathing
I follow your footprints
The cliffs return your sound to me
You are climbing higher
I am waiting for you to tire
My wings cut off your retreat
I can smell your sweat
This cliff has one path only
I close in, slowly
Your torch is shaking
I listen to the echo of stone
You have only a few steps left
No rush, gargoyles are patient
You knocked a stone loose
I know exactly where you are
The night hides me for you
I am already at your back
My stone claw rakes your shoulder
I bring my fist down
My stone arm sweeps across
I sink my teeth into your wrist.
My stone tail whips your leg
My weight knocks you back
This blow comes with grit
I drop on you from above
My stone fangs tear your armor
You stiffen for a moment
The stone is creeping up you
I pin you and press down
Your knees are turning to stone
A stone fist finds your chest
I turn and strike again
You hear your own bones answer
My claws pulled no punch
A gargoyle's wrath is heavy
The peak splits and I wake
I tear free of the cliff face
Moonlight finds my horns first
Rubble rolls down the stony shore
A statue opens its eyes
I shake off the moss
My stone wings open for the first time
A new shadow joins the ridge
I am carved into the night
The sleeping statue stands
The wind carries my name downhill
A low growl squeezes from the cracks
I am born from a wound in the cliff
The night takes up its watch
The flame leaves only a black mark
I land and leave a crater
Water fills my cracks and I sink
The blast tears off half my stone plate
The arrow snaps on my stone skin
Magic gnaws my hide and leaves it numb
No moonlight for long, and I grow heavy

lines.zh: 闪电顺着石纹走了一圈
lines.en: Lightning runs around my seams
Even stone dissolves as I fall
